init.title: pCloud Sync options
init.description: Choose what is uploaded and what happens afterwards. Tip: enable **Dry run** first to see in the log what would happen.

data_description.remote_folder: Everything is uploaded below this pCloud folder.

folders.name: Local folders & filters
folders.description: One folder per line. Optional remote sub folder: `/media/frigate/clips -> frigate/clips`. Folders must be allowed in Home Assistant (`allowlist_external_dirs`; `/media` is allowed by default).

data_description.watch_folders: Local folders whose files are uploaded (sub folders included).

data.conflict_mode: If the file already exists in pCloud

data_description.scan_interval: How often watch folders are scanned. 0 = only manually (button / action).
data_description.min_file_age: Files changed more recently are skipped (they may still be written).
data_description.delete_after_upload: Deletes a local file ONLY after pCloud confirmed the upload with a matching SHA-1 checksum. Off = local files are never touched.
data_description.date_subfolders: Put snapshots / Frigate events / uploaded files into YYYY/MM/DD sub folders.
data_description.conflict_mode: Rename keeps both files, overwrite creates a new revision in pCloud.
data_description.dry_run: Nothing is uploaded or deleted, every action is only logged.

cache.name: Local cache (optional)
cache.description: Data that does not exist as a file (camera snapshots, Frigate clips) is normally uploaded straight from memory. With the cache it is first written to disk: large clips do not use RAM and failed uploads are retried on the next sync. Cached files are always removed after a verified upload.

data_description.cache_path: Must be inside the config folder or an allowed folder. Note: a folder inside /config is part of Home Assistant backups.

data_description.frigate_url: Base URL of the Frigate API, e.g. `http://ccab4aaf-frigate:5000` (add-on) or `http://192.168.1.10:5000`. Used by the `upload_frigate_event` action.

data_description.max_files_per_run: Remaining files are uploaded in the next run.
data_description.max_parallel_uploads: How many uploads run at the same time (1-4).
data_description.upload_timeout: Maximum duration of a single upload.

error.invalid_remote_folder: Invalid pCloud folder. Use an absolute path without '..' (not '/').
error.watch_folder_not_allowed: Home Assistant does not allow access to {path}. Add it to `allowlist_external_dirs` in configuration.yaml.
error.invalid_cache_path: Cache folder must be an absolute path: {path}
error.cache_path_not_allowed: Cache folder {path} is neither inside the config folder nor an allowed folder.
error.cache_overlaps_watch_folder: Cache folder {path} must not be inside a watch folder (or contain one).
error.invalid_frigate_url: The Frigate URL must start with http:// or https://.
